stores.voucherTermsHint: Printed under the "VOUCHER TERMS" heading on refund vouchers, one line per item. Leave blank to use the cashier's default text (shown in grey in the box). Reaches the cashiers only after you publish the receipt profile.
stores.installmentTermsHint: Printed under the "INSTALLMENT TERMS" heading on in-progress installment receipts, one line per item. Leave blank to use the cashier's default text (shown in grey in the box). Reaches the cashiers only after you publish the receipt profile.
stores.batchTermsHint: When selected, leaving this blank clears the custom text and the cashiers go back to the default; one line per item
stores.cashRegisterToggleHint: When disabled, the store's cashier system is unavailable

receiptProfile.tipNever: No receipt profile has been published to this store's cashiers yet
receiptProfile.tipSynced: Current profile matches the latest published version v{{version}}
receiptProfile.tipPending: Current profile differs from the latest published version v{{version}}; publish again to send it to the cashiers
receiptProfile.deviceOpenTip: Rollout of v{{version}}; click for per-device detail
receiptProfile.pendingHint: {{count}} on this page with unpublished edits
receiptProfile.selectPendingTip: Select the stores on this page that have unpublished edits, for batch publishing
receiptProfile.selectPendingTruncated: A batch holds at most 100 stores. The selection is full; publish the rest in another batch.
receiptProfile.statusLoadFailed: Receipt publish status could not be loaded. The store list is unaffected.
receiptProfile.statusUnavailable: The server does not provide receipt publishing yet. The store list is unaffected.
receiptProfile.publishIntro: After you confirm, cashiers apply the profile below automatically within about a minute. Once a cashier has received a publication, these fields become read-only there; edit them here and publish again.
receiptProfile.publishNothing: The selected stores have no changes to publish
receiptProfile.publishLoadFailed: Failed to load the before/after comparison
receiptProfile.publishConflict: Someone else is publishing at the same time. Please retry.
receiptProfile.publishRejected: Nothing was published (no store was written). Fix the following and retry.
receiptProfile.missingStores: {{count}} store(s) no longer exist and are left out of this publish
receiptProfile.devicesHint: Cashiers check for a new version about every 60 seconds; offline devices apply it once they reconnect.
receiptProfile.devicesNeverPublished: No receipt profile has been published for this store yet
receiptProfile.devicesEmpty: This store has no active cashier devices
receiptProfile.devicesLoadFailed: Failed to load the device rollout
